mission: M3HZ - Detector 0 manual label ingestion contract no Brev
purpose: Define the validation, provenance, human-review, and forbidden-input contract that a later local ingestion slice must satisfy before Detector 0 workbench draft exports may become authoritative label artifacts.

docs/session-logs/715-mission-3hy-detect.summary: M3HY reviewed the M3HX workbench as safe for draft-only local annotation review and not authoritative label evidence, training readiness, browser promotion readiness, final-gate evidence, or claim expansion evidence.

tools/detector0-annotator/prepare.py.role: Creates ignored local PNG/index cache from tracked Tier 0 tensors and packet metadata.

tools/detector0-annotator/app.html.role: Static local browser draft-box editor and draft JSON exporter.

tools/detector0-annotator/README.md.role: Documents local-only, draft-only, no-upload, no-inference, no-training, no-claim-change boundaries.

tools/detector0-annotator/.gitignore.role: Ignores .cache, exports, and draft JSON/JSONL/NDJSON outputs.

row_id: must be unique within the draft export
must resolve to exactly one tracked workbench-index frame or one later approved candidate-row source
must not conflict with a different split, label_id, clip_id, frame_index, tensor path, source_record_id, or source hash
split: must be one of train, validation, or test
must match the tracked source row and must not move rows across splits
label_id: must match the tracked source row
must be a return-to-form Tier 0 label or a later source-reviewed hard-negative label only when that later source review exists
clip_id: must match the tracked manifest/source row
must not be reused for a different source_record_id
frame_index: must match the tracked candidate row
must be within the retained tensor frame count for the referenced tensor
tensor_path: must exist in the tracked repo state used for ingestion
must match the packet/index tensor path for the row
tensor_hashes: must match the source packet/index tensor_file_sha256 or packet frame/tensor digest
must fail ingestion on missing, changed, or untraceable tensor hashes
coordinate_space: may be accepted as equivalent to the older packet alias normalized_full_frame_xyxy_top_left_origin only when the ingestion receipt records the alias mapping explicitly

box_rules: present targets require box_xyxy_norm as four finite numeric values
box coordinates must satisfy 0 <= x1 < x2 <= 1 and 0 <= y1 < y2 <= 1
present targets must not use zero-area, negative-area, NaN, infinity, string, or pixel-space coordinates
unknown target ids must fail ingestion unless a later committed target-policy artifact explicitly adds them
missing_target_rules: promoted hand targets missing from an applicable draft row must be treated as unresolved, not absent
fixed anchor targets may remain fixed-geometry anchors and must not be silently overwritten by drafts
diagnostic-only table union/contact must remain absent or diagnostic unless both manual hand boxes support it under the target policy

required_per_row_source_fields: source_video_sha256 or equivalent reviewed source hash
signer_identity_hash when present in the source row
input_must_be_rejected_when: source row is absent from the source register or later approved source-review artifact
license status is not approved for the exact annotation scope
provenance omits reviewer identity or approval reference
any pretrained, generated, pseudo-label, network, or learner-media origin is detected

reviewer_identity_or_approval_reference: must identify the human reviewer or committed approval artifact
must not be inferred from a local browser export timestamp alone
must be preserved in the future ingestion receipt

absence_semantics.true_absent: The target is not present in the retained frame and the reviewer explicitly records that absence.
absence_semantics.not_applicable: The target policy says the target does not apply to this row or label context.
absence_semantics.insufficient_visual_evidence: The retained frame cannot support a reliable target decision; this blocks promotion for that target.
absence_semantics.occluded_or_truncated: The target is present but visibility is limited and the reviewer records occlusion or truncation metadata.
absence_semantics.unresolved: The draft or review lacks enough evidence; unresolved must not be promoted as absent.

promoted_visual_target_applicable_if_vis: requires manual present box, true_absent, or insufficient_visual_evidence review
fixed_geometry_context_anchor: may remain fixed anchor metadata and does not create learned-detector improvement claims
diagnostic_only_auxiliary_table_contact_: requires both manual hand boxes and remains diagnostic-only

duplicate_conflict_and_bounds_handling.duplicate_rows: Reject exports with duplicate row_id entries unless every field and target is byte-identical and the ingestion receipt explicitly de-duplicates them.
duplicate_conflict_and_bounds_handling.existing_authoritative_conflicts: Reject or quarantine any draft that changes an already authoritative target without an explicit conflict-resolution artifact.
duplicate_conflict_and_bounds_handling.draft_target_conflicts: Reject rows where multiple draft targets for the same row_id/target_id disagree.
duplicate_conflict_and_bounds_handling.coordinate_bounds: Reject any present box outside normalized bounds, with inverted coordinates, or with too little area to represent a target.
duplicate_conflict_and_bounds_handling.missing_targets: Classify missing applicable promoted hand targets as unresolved, not absent.
duplicate_conflict_and_bounds_handling.insufficient_visual_evidence: Preserve blockers exactly; do not copy temporal-neighbor boxes or fixed boxes into unresolved frames.
duplicate_conflict_and_bounds_handling.source_mismatch: Reject drafts where row identity matches but source hashes, tensor hashes, or manifest metadata do not.

may_propose_to_update.condition: Only for a later committed local ingestion slice that promotes reviewed supplemental manual rows with complete provenance and human-review proof.
Only if a later human-reviewed source of evidence resolves a preserved blocker without extrapolating unsupported labels.
Only if a later explicitly scoped packet refresh is approved; M3HZ does not authorize mutation of this V0 packet.

may_propose_to_create.condition: A future local ingestion slice may create a new authoritative supplemental artifact rather than mutating existing packets, if it records all contract validations and review approvals.

forbidden_input_proof.generated_labels: Draft exports must not contain generated labels, pseudo-labels, model predictions, or teacher labels.
forbidden_input_proof.pretrained_outputs: Draft exports must not originate from MediaPipe, OpenPose, YOLO, SAM, DINO, CLIP, from_pretrained, pretrained=True, pretrained detector outputs, pretrained landmarks, pretrained embeddings, or pretrained feature caches.
forbidden_input_proof.raw_learner_media: Draft exports must not contain raw learner video, learner frames, learner identifiers, or upload-derived data.
forbidden_input_proof.network_exports: Draft exports must not be accepted from network submissions, remote URLs, cloud sync, telemetry, browser sendBeacon/fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket/EventSource, or unreviewed downloaded media.
forbidden_input_proof.source_unapproved_media: Rows from sources not explicitly approved for the exact annotation scope must fail ingestion.
